coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch completed with 12 targeted fresh-web searches across four audit miss classes: only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss; storm/flood/fire/outage-related food-distribution cancellation or suspension; abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major service reduction; and official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences. Search results were reviewed for freshness and qualifying access impact. No new qualifying signal was identified in the observation window. Hurricane-related Hawaii food-bank closure material surfaced again but was previously known and therefore excluded as duplicate/recycled reporting. Donation drives, resource guides, routine assistance promotion, generic inflation coverage, opinion, and unsupported claims were excluded.
